text:
Amelia: Hey kitchen crew — there9s a half sheet cake in the fridge from Friday9s social labeled "for anyone" but it looks like end pieces vanished overnight. If you grabbed the last good slice pls own up :grimacing: Also we9re low on oat milk and the compost bag is nearly full. Can someone run to the corner store today? @Sam @Priya
SnackBot: Automated kitchen alert: fridge temp normal. Inventory low: oat milk (1 left), compost bags (1), decaf pods (0).
Sam: I can do a quick run at 12:30. What should I grab? Any brand constraints?
Jordan: Please get barista oat (if possible) — it foams better. Also can we have a "no nibblers" sign? Someone keeps taking two bites of other people's snacks. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
Priya: I9ll pick up bananas and a box of nut-free cookies for lunch guests tomorrow. If Sam can do oat milk + decaf pods that9d be awesome. Also maybe small compost liners?
Amelia: Thanks both! Sam — add "small compost liners" to the list. And Sam/Priya, please put receipts in the paper clip tin. If anyone wants cake, eat now and label the Tupperware with your name.
Sam: Shopping list (short): `oat milk (barista, 1), decaf pods (1 box), compost liners (small), recycling bags` I9ll lock up and be back ~12:50.
SnackBot: Kitchen note saved: new suggested sign "Please label shared food / no nibbling" uploaded. Template: no-nibblers.png
Sam: Back from the store — oat milk and decaf in the pantry, compost liners under sink, left receipt on counter. Also I took one tiny cake slice for quality control. No regrets. :satisfied:
